text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A doctor who was accused of sexually harrassing his patients is suspended from duty for six months.
- The 82th anniversary of the Turkish victory in the Gallipoli battle was celebrated on Tuesday.
- Islamist State Minister Abdullah Gul says his Welfare Party is in favour of Turkey entering the European Union.
- Greek and Turkish students visit the Istanbul-based Greek Orthodox Patriarch Bartholomeos to begin a dialogue between traditional foes Turks and Greek.
- School teachers are given even lower pay rises than religious preachers.
- There are more than 400 illegal Koran teaching centres throughout Turkey.
- The Islamist-led government's populist economic policies fly in the face of International Monetary Fund recommendations.
- The main opposition Motherland Party is gearing up to monitor a fund for those in hardship after allegations that the goverment was making use of it to win votes.
